plugins.name: svelte-house-rules
plugins.description: Process discipline, library preferences, engineering taste, Tailwind v4 styling, animations that avoid layout overlap, iOS keyboard fixes, error handling, PostHog analytics, and swipe carousels for Svelte 5 / SvelteKit on Cloudflare Workers. Triggers when the project uses Svelte, SvelteKit, Drizzle, D1, Tailwind v4, vaul-svelte, bits-ui, runed, valibot, svelte-sonner, carta-md, date-fns-tz, mode-watcher, paraglide-js, or river.ts.
